title: Austin's Early 20th Century Urban Focus
summary:
*   Approved extensive new street grades and elevation points for major thoroughfares, including Rio Grande Street and West Avenue, crucial for urban development.
*   Endorsed the Chamber of Commerce's push to bring U.S. troops from Texas City to Camp Mabry in Austin, a significant local economic and defense initiative.
*   Authorized a temporary $4,000 loan from the city's general fund to bolster the general street fund, supporting infrastructure projects.
*   Addressed individual matters by suspending court fines for several people and approving medical and ambulance payments for a city fireman injured on duty.

August 26th 1915
• The Chair laid before the Council the following resolution : Whereas, the Chamber of
Commerce of the City of Austin, Texas, has made application to the Federal authorities at
Washington, D. C, that the United States troops to be moved from Texas City be brought to
Camp Mabry in Austin, Texas; and
Resolution
Whereas, it is desired by the City Council of the City of Austin, Texas, to ratify and
concur with the action of the Chamber of Commerce, therefore, Be it resolved by the City
Council of the City of Austin, Texas : To Camp That the action of the Chamber of Commerce
of the City of Austin, Texas, and Mabry their efforts in bringing the United States troops
to be moved from Texas City to the City of Austin, be and are hereby fully concurred in
and ratified by th this body .
Be it further resolved :
That a copy of this resolution be furnished the Chamber of Commerce to be used by them as
they see fit.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Councilmen Anthony, Bartholomew,
Haynes & Powell 4 Nays none.
August 27th 1915.

Sept 1st 1915.
The Chair laid before the Council application from Will Owens , for Drivers license, which
was granted by the following vote : Yeas Councilmen Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell
4 Nays none.
The Chair laid before the Council the following resolution: Be it resolved by the City
Council of the City of Austin : Transfer funds That the sum of $ 4,000.00, be and the same
is hereby appropriated out of the General street fund General fund of the City- to the
General street fund, and that the City Clerk be , and is hereby instructed to draw a
warrant in favor of the General street fund for said amount.
This amount being a temporary loan to the General street fund and to be returned to the
General fund , with such interest as may be paid on overdraft.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Councilmen Bartholomew, Haynes &
Powell 3
Absent Councilman Anthony 1
The Council then adjourned .
J. G. Johnson
City Clerk
